response.original_title: Van Jong tot Oud: Historische filmbeelden uit de Zaanstreek
response.overview: How were health, sport, leisure, care and everyday life viewed in the past? As part of the Month of History, the Zaanstad Municipal Archives presents a special film evening featuring an exclusive compilation of historical footage from its own film collection. The compilation shows how residents of the Zaan region worked, exercised, relaxed, lived and cared for one another over the years. The screening offers a unique glimpse into the past of the Zaan region.
response.title: From Young to Old: Historical Film Footage from the Zaan Region
